journey: Ingest-token replay — lease-folded HMAC, verify-before-lookup: wrong-token & non-lease are identical 401s

narrative.step: POSITIVE CONTROL — a real HELD lease exists (a genuine ingest target)
ATTACK — a captured/forged token replayed on the real lease → 401 (folds the wrong lease_id)
narrative.assertion: forged token on real lease → 401 (HMAC folds lease_id; cross-lease replay fails)

narrative.step: ATTACK — the same forged token on an UNKNOWN lease → the same 401 (auth precedes lookup: no oracle)
narrative.assertion: unknown lease → 401; identical to real-lease 401 → true (constant-time verify before registry lookup)

artifact.gap: Replay on the SAME lease with its OWN valid token is allowed-but-bounded (appends to that one lease's bounded, non-persisted feed) — verifying that requires the lease's genuine ingest token.
artifact.reachableFrom: in-box only — the in-box agent holding that lease's real ingest token.
